'''Joinde''' is a [[Maiden of the Spear]]. She is [[Black Rock]] [[Shaarad]].

== Activities ==
She is affected by [[Rand al'Thor]]'s ''[[ta'veren]]'' nature and lays a [[bridal wreath]] at [[Garan]]'s feet.{{ref/book|5|3}} He was her [[Gai'shain]] but their clans were also in blood feud.
